name: model-fit
description: After each ask you type, says what it looked like it needed and what it cost; after a simple or routine ask on a bigger model or effort than it needed, what Haiku, Sonnet or a lower effort would have cost; warns when an ask runs on too small a model or a complex one at low effort; says when the context has grown expensive and how to shrink it; ships /model-fit:baton, a handoff note for a fresh session. Optional Jev shadow labels for comparison.

cacheTtl.title: Prompt cache lifetime
cacheTtl.description: auto: worked out from your settings and environment (an hour on a subscription, five minutes with an API key or a cloud provider). Set 5m when a subscription has run into usage credits, which model-fit cannot see.

jevShadow.title: Jev shadow labels
jevShadow.description: on: Jev labels each ask beside Haiku and /fit compares them. Haiku still drives the advice. Sends the ask and the end of the last reply to TypeSafe.

jevModel.title: Jev model
jevModel.description: Pinned so the shadow comparison stays on one model. jev-1.14.0 is newer; jev-latest follows whatever TypeSafe points it at.

typesafeApiKey.title: TypeSafe API key
typesafeApiKey.description: Key for Jev shadow labels. Left empty, TYPESAFE_API_KEY is used.
